releaseNotes.title: Organic Acid Algorithm Closure
releaseNotes.body: Added task definition, feature schema, scoring equation, mode weights, risk penalty, ranking, sanity check, and sensitivity analysis.

releaseNotes.title: Sanity and Sensitivity Checks
releaseNotes.body: Top candidates now carry sanity-check flags, mode sensitivity context, data gaps, and next experiments.

releaseNotes.title: Organic Acid Screening Report
releaseNotes.body: Research Reports now includes a natural-language Organic Acid Screening Report from the same algorithm output.

releaseNotes.title: Performance Priority Modes
releaseNotes.body: Added performance priority mode and priority-impact explanations across scoring and trace surfaces.

releaseNotes.title: Readable Research Reports
releaseNotes.body: Added clearer executive summaries, sections, and chart packs.

releaseNotes.title: Research Outputs Framework
releaseNotes.body: Added first-level Research Reports tab with candidate, comparison, screening, and validation reports.

releaseNotes.title: Full Localization Refactor
releaseNotes.body: Added terminology whitelist, scientific language guide, and localization audit outputs.

releaseNotes.title: Run Snapshot and Citation Package
releaseNotes.body: Reports now include run snapshots, citation packages, data sources, field sources, source links, and citation status.

releaseNotes.title: Research Output Tests
releaseNotes.body: Added tests for localization audit, terminology consistency, report generation, reproducibility snapshots, and citation packages.

releaseNotes.title: Project Evolution Center
releaseNotes.body: Added first-level Project Evolution tab with unified version timeline, release notes, roadmap, milestones, and evolution charts.

releaseNotes.title: Knowledge Architecture Refactor
releaseNotes.body: Methods & Evidence now focuses on how EcoMOF-AI works and links to Project Evolution for project history.

releaseNotes.title: First-Level Project Evolution Tab
releaseNotes.body: Promoted Project Evolution to the main navigation so version history no longer lives inside Methods & Evidence.

releaseNotes.title: Evolution Center Test Coverage
releaseNotes.body: Added component and data-source checks for timeline, release notes, database growth, algorithm evolution, validation evolution, milestones, and roadmap.

releaseNotes.title: 1000 Candidate Database Preview
releaseNotes.body: Expanded scalable Database Preview to 1000 candidates with explicit synthetic fixture labels.

releaseNotes.title: Verified Metadata Breakthrough
releaseNotes.body: Strict verifiedMetadataCount reached 30 while sourceConfirmedCount remained separate.

releaseNotes.title: Model Validation Lab
releaseNotes.body: Added feature selection, model comparison, confidence analysis, and pending-only model metrics.

releaseNotes.title: Screening Trace
releaseNotes.body: Added trace timeline, funnel, candidate dashboard, compare mode, readiness matrix, and next action panel.

releaseNotes.title: Manual Source Curation
releaseNotes.body: Separated source_confirmed and citation_ready from verified_metadata.

releaseNotes.title: Evidence Backfill
releaseNotes.body: Made evidence gaps auditable and visible before verified candidate reports.
